A '''warehouse''' on<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> the terrestrial [[planet]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> [[Fresia]]<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> in the [[Core Worlds]]<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Fresia system]]</ref> was owned by the [[Incom Corporation]], who used it to store [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]]s produced by the company. After the resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]] realized the potential of the [[X-wing starfighter]]s, he and his [[partisans]] conducted a violent [[Raid on an Incom warehouse|raid]] on the warehouse<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> at some point between [[19 BBY]] and [[5 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes that the [[raid on an Incom warehouse]] took place between the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] and the events of "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]." The book dates the Empire's formation and the events of "Narkina 5" to [[19 BBY]] and [[5 BBY]], respectively.</ref> and [[Thief|stole]] eight X-wings during the raid, using them to form the [[Cavern Angels]] [[squadron]].<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Incom Corporation warehouse was mentioned in the [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'',<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> within a section written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="DawnAuthor">{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews - Emily Shkoukani & Jason Fry}}</ref>
